scope: LIVE // EARTH Weather Live Art studio only

productionStandard.style: original artist-led ink, wash and pigment painting generated directly on canvas
productionStandard.newArtworkRule: Clear artwork must be authored as an original painting score. The renderer deposits pigment through brush dynamics onto a persistent canvas; no finished image, source artwork, reveal atlas, or image-derived masks may be loaded.
productionStandard.canvasSurface: programmatic warm-fibre paper texture; no source-image texture
productionStandard.replayRule: Every intermediate frame must contain only pigment already deposited by the artist engine. Completion does not swap, uncover, or copy a finished image.
